method: Codex full-catalog review and a fresh independent verification request for proposed changes; no tools or private data supplied to the model.
scope: 71 bundled app catalogs, including English; 582 messages per catalog. Third-party license bodies are preserved verbatim.
runtime_corrections: Tutor route summaries retain canonical technique names for translation and capture complete shape/ending sentences.
Preparation preserves exact fragment boundary whitespace and is idempotent.
limits: This is a model-assisted linguistic review, not native-speaker certification.
Uncertain regional technique terminology and context-dependent fragment suggestions were not applied.
Android UI checks use the API 36 16 KB emulator; actual camera recognition and Play-delivered installation are outside this translation review.

languages.name: Kiswahili

languages.name: Esperanto
